'''Qilqu''' was a male [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served onboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. Qilqu tried to coerce [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] into resting after the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Duel on the ''Anakin Solo'']], a suggestion Jacen refused and sent him away for.
